column1: # Each nation's oil and gas consumption and its crude production, the latest year EIA reports for each series.
# oil_kbd: petroleum and other liquids consumption, thousand barrels a day (series INTL.5-2-<ISO>-TBPD.A). gas_bcm: dry natural gas
# consumption, billion cubic meters (INTL.26-2-<ISO>-BCM.A). crude_kbd: crude oil including lease condensate production, thousand barrels
# a day (INTL.57-1-<ISO>-TBPD.A). A blank cell is a series EIA does not report. source: US EIA International Energy Statistics bulk file.
